name: Sign-in mascot and accessible auth shell render

planSteps.description: Open https://muster.orazen.online/sign-in in a fresh unauthenticated browser context. Do not sign in or submit a form.
The welcome mascot exposes an accessible button named Wave to Muster. Its decorative SVG is hidden from assistive technology; do not require it to be an image named Muster teammate.
The heading Your day, with Muster. is visible inside the form panel, along with Your personal workspace.
The Muster home link, Need a hand? link and Skip to form link are present.
Focus moves to the auth form panel, which is labelled by the sign-in heading; the Get the desktop app link points to /download.html.
